name: 21_magnetrons
title: Vaned magnetrons (2D EM): A6 experiment and Hull / Buneman-Hartree window

rows.case: A6 (360 kV, 0.8 T): fundamental / cold-test pi-mode frequency (oscillates in the pi mode)
A6: fundamental vs measured ~2.3 GHz (Palevsky & Bekefi 1979)
planar, inside Hull-BH window: fundamental / cold-test pi mode
planar, B above the BH field: cavity field rms / in-window rms (quiet, < 0.1)

notes: A6 thresholds at 360 kV: smooth-bore Hull B* = 0.508 T (Lovelace-Ott), pi-mode BH field 0.825 T; the run at 0.8 T sits in the window. 2D result per metre of axial length x 7.2 cm: anode current 2.29 kA, port power 85 MW, electronic efficiency 10.3 %. Experiment (Bekefi & Orzechowski 1976): ~12 kA, ~1.7 GW at ~360 kV, ~0.8 T - the 2D model has no axial end loss and its output (loss port, loaded Q = 250) is not the experimental extraction, so current and power are indicative only; the frequency and mode are the benchmark. Planar magnetron at 170 kV: Hull field B_H = 0.150 T, pi-mode BH field 0.180 T (v_ph = 0.390 c); B = 0.16 T is inside the window (oscillates, f = 5.710 GHz), B = 0.19 T is above the BH field (V < V_BH: no oscillation, field rms ratio 0.004).
